h:
它专为一个人的全身拍摄而设计。如果有多个面孔，结果就不好。此外，它不适用于肖像（脸部特写） - 反而会降低质量。


使用过的模型（只是因为它们很快）：

  • https://openmodeldb.info/models/2x-NomosUni-esrgan-multijpg

  • https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-Nomos2-realplksr-dysample

您可以从舒适的模型管理器下载面部分割，并从以下位置下载面部恢复模型https://huggingface.co/datasets/Gourieff/ReActor/tree/main/models/facerestore_models

如果未检测到面部，请将 SEGM 检测器“阈值”降低至 0.2 等值。

在4090上执行大约需要7s

有一堆自定义节点，但这些都是非常基本的，下载它们应该没有问题。

o.en:
Its made for full body shots with one person. If there's multiple faces results will not be good. Also it will not work with portraits (face closeup) - will rather degrade quality.


Used models (just because those are fast):

  • https://openmodeldb.info/models/2x-NomosUni-esrgan-multijpg

  • https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-Nomos2-realplksr-dysample

You can download face segmentation from comfy model manager and face restore models fromhttps://huggingface.co/datasets/Gourieff/ReActor/tree/main/models/facerestore_models

Decrease SEGM Detector "threshold" to value like 0.2 if face is not detected.

Takes about 7s to execute on 4090

There's bunch of custom nodes, but those are quite fundamental and comfy should have no problem downloading those.
